plan.summary:
The cache size can now be set with the `CACHE_MB` environment variable.

- `cacheConfig` parses `env.CACHE_MB` as a number.
- It uses the value only when it is finite and greater than 0.
- Otherwise it uses `DEFAULT_MEGABYTES`, as before.
plan.riskRationale: Small change in one function. Invalid input falls back to the old default.
plan.storyArc: One change: `cacheConfig` reads `CACHE_MB` and validates it. It falls back to the default for a bad value.

topics.title: Read and validate CACHE_MB in cacheConfig
topics.narrativeBrief: How does `cacheConfig` choose the cache size now? Verify that unset, non-numeric, zero, negative, and infinite values all fall back to `DEFAULT_MEGABYTES`.
